entries.df5b575c18fbd1a8: Building construction works that construct buildings such as schools, hospitals, factories, offices and condominiums. It receives orders for railway-related buildings and for buildings of government agencies and the private sector, and also operates the SMIC seismic reinforcement method business. Completed construction revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥32,492 million.
entries.e695d12c7391a4f5: A general contractor with strength in railway construction, which undertakes civil engineering and building construction work and buys, sells and leases real estate.
entries.f3654859f41ab020: A business that sells land and buildings and leases properties such as rental offices. Stable rental income comes from the office building "JP Tower Nagoya," a joint business with Japan Post Co., Ltd., and others. The consolidated subsidiary Meiko Shoji Co., Ltd. operates agency business for non-life insurance arising in connection with each business, and others. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,209 million.
entries.f997d89c22fd093d: A business operating civil engineering and building construction as a general construction contractor. It builds roads, railways, and water and sewage systems, and constructs schools, hospitals, factories, offices and condominiums; part of the construction work it undertakes is ordered from subsidiaries and others engaged in the construction business. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥95,744 million, accounting for the majority of consolidated revenue.

entries.fd0cbfec9d1d710e: Civil engineering works that build social infrastructure such as roads, railways, and water and sewage systems.
entries.fdb5bd32c04cdf16: Civil engineering works that build social infrastructure such as roads, railways, and water and sewage systems. Centered on railway-related construction, it carries out safety measures for the Shinkansen, large-scale renovations, construction work on the Chuo Shinkansen, and maintenance and repair of existing infrastructure. Completed construction revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥63,251 million.
